title: Should I Put Pricing On My Website ? Answer: YES! [Tips + Video]

facts.fact: The same vendor survey found that 84% of respondents think the pricing on a website is the most important component when looking at companies to choose from.
facts.quote: That same survey revealed that 84% think the pricing on a website is the most important component when looking at companies to choose from.

facts.fact: The vendor states that studies show that on average, 80% of the buying decision for major purchases is made by the customer before contacting a company or salesperson today.
facts.quote: Studies show that on average, 80% of the buying decision for major purchases is made by the customer today before they walk in your door

facts.fact: The vendor says the share of the buying decision made by customers before contacting a company was closer to 70% five years before the page was written.
facts.quote: Five years ago it was closer to 70%.

facts.fact: The article was published by Sutherland Weston on May 19, 2025.
